map.阿伦尼乌斯基于活化能，对硫化这类化学反应更准确，尤其跨温度较大时；范德霍夫「每: Arrhenius is based on activation energy and is more accurate for reactions such as vulcanization, especially across a wide temperature range; van't Hoff's "time halves every 10°C" is an empirical approximation that only holds in a narrow temperature range, so a large deviation between the two means the range has moved outside the empirical scope.
